# PEACHES Floor reference checker

Unmodified `floor.py` and upstream tests/CLI/specification from https://github.com/Grativy6/book-of-peaches at 6b12e184ad90e8cc210e90511e39ea3838fe7459 (peaches-book 0.2.0). See LICENSE, NOTICE and LICENSE-SCOPE.md.

`h1.floor.json` is the retained public H1 founding envelope, copied byte-for-byte for Chris's private pilot and offline inspection. It is a historical record outside the new blanket Apache grant. Its inclusion adds no private ancestry or signing key. H1 is an optional origin, never another user's default identity.

Branchline's package and native key UI are separate first-party integration code in the parent directory. This is the published reference checker used outside and inside the app, not a claim of independently authored verification.
